description.value: The Tatla Lake Branch is a small community library operated by the Cariboo Regional District Library system, situated on BC-20 (the Chilcotin Highway) in the remote Tatla Lake settlement of the Central Interior. Staffed by a community librarian, it is one of the few public facilities along this long, sparsely serviced highway corridor popular with cycle tourists. As a publicly accessible institution, it represents a rare community hub in a stretch of BC where services are few and far between.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the physical address (16451 BC-20, Tatla Lake, BC, V0L 1V0), phone (250-476-1242), and email (tatla@cariboord.ca), all matching OSM. The website is a contact-only page with no mention of cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi); the OSM tag internet_access=wlan cannot be treated as authoritative per rules, so Wi-Fi is null. None of the required criteria can be confirmed or denied from available evidence.
concerns: Website is a minimal contact-info page only; no amenity information is present to confirm or deny any required or optional criteria.
Category 'Attractions' is a poor fit for a community library branch; more appropriate as a service stop or rest point.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The library is a legitimate, confirmed-open public facility along the cycle-touring BC-20 Chilcotin Highway corridor, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) can be confirmed from the available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to determine whether it meets the minimum threshold for inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Tatla Lake is a very remote community on the Chilcotin Highway (BC-20), making even a small library branch potentially high-value to cycle tourists. Direct outreach to the community librarian (Karen Paul, tatla@cariboord.ca) would quickly resolve all null amenity fields.
